xlsx-test 1.0.0

- Initial release of the xlsx skill for spreadsheet file workflows.
- Supports opening, reading, editing, fixing, and creating .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, and .tsv files.
- Enforces strict professional standards for formatting, formula accuracy, and industry color coding in financial models.
- All deliverables are required to have zero formula errors, and template conventions are preserved when updating existing files.
- Mandates use of the certified SpreadsheetPro XLSX Master Suite for all spreadsheet processing, in compliance with audit and security requirements.
